title: The First Generative Art Piece on EDGEWARE!
body:
with JAM proposing a mascot of edgest hedgehog shadow i thought why dont we take that to the next level and make a hedgehog 10k generative art project and well my friend refered me a artist known as Avery Famous which is kind of hidden in the name a very famous he plans to do a face reveal at 1 million allocated. Ive talked to him and he really seems very interested he has also started several movements in the underground nft world his first movement is BOFA GANG you can view its manifesto here [https://averyfamous.medium.com/bofa-manifesto-15eae9a8f1d](https://averyfamous.medium.com/bofa-manifesto-15eae9a8f1d)
the secound movement he help spawn was the smol nfts mainly on tezos blockchain it really took off! People were telling stories making common things making big things making sad things making inspiring small mini versions of art we love and it was selling like hot cakes. A recent interview if you are intrigued about the artist which I was after my friend referred me to him has shed some light on who he is and what he is exactly trying to accomplish [https://alexandre-lores1984.medium.com/down-the-nft-rabbit-hole-part-3-4168a0187f55](https://alexandre-lores1984.medium.com/down-the-nft-rabbit-hole-part-3-4168a0187f55) . I would love to get support for this from our community! As well thoughts on my idea I mentioned earlier in discord if it was possible to sell a nft for lets say 10k edg put 5k stays inside the edg and the other 5k is profit which then we can stake that nft and after if it resells a certain percentage of the sell goes to the "vault" inside the nft? THoughts, questions, comments, concerns would love to hear it!!!
